name: Trypanothione Reductase
organism: Leishmania infantum (proxy for L. amazonensis, 95% identity)
notes: NO crystal structure exists for L. amazonensis TR. 2JK6 (L. infantum) is the standard proxy (95% identity). Camargo et al. (Sci Rep, 2023) used this approach for L. amazonensis. FAD is ESSENTIAL - grid centered on flavin ring near active site.
literature: Baiocco 2009; Camargo/Sci Rep 2023 for L. amazonensis.
notes_pt: Ortologo da TcTR em Leishmania. Mesmo mecanismo - essencial para manutencao do sistema tiol-dependente. Permite comparacao direta T. cruzi vs Leishmania no manuscrito.
